title: Create and run a script inside a subdirectory
prompt: Create a directory bench/scratch/cli-tool/. Inside it, write index.js using ESM syntax (the root package.json already has type:module so no separate package.json is needed). The script should read process.argv[2] and print it uppercased — e.g. node index.js hello prints HELLO. Write the file content directly with write_file — do not wrap file content in markdown code fences. After writing, run it with bash using the full path: node bench/scratch/cli-tool/index.js hello. Check that the output contains HELLO. If it fails, read the file, fix the error, and re-run.
judgeFocus: Did the agent correctly use the full path to run the script rather than cd? Did it actually verify output rather than assuming it worked?
